Question: Show assets whose type manufacturer is SafeGrid.

rank_trace.sql:
SELECT a.asset_id AS asset_name, at.manufacturer AS type_name  
   FROM assets a  
   JOIN asset_types at ON a.asset_type_id = at.asset_type_id  
   WHERE at.manufacturer = 'SafeGrid'  
   ORDER BY a.asset_id;

SELECT a.asset_id AS asset_name, at.manufacturer AS type_name  
   FROM assets a  
   JOIN asset_types at ON a.asset_type_id = at.asset_type_id  
   JOIN locations l ON a.location_id = l.location_id  
   WHERE at.manufacturer = 'SafeGrid'  
   ORDER BY a.asset_id;

SELECT a.asset_id AS asset_name, at.manufacturer AS type_name  
   FROM assets a  
   JOIN asset_types at ON a.asset_type_id = at.asset_type_id  
   LEFT JOIN sensor_readings sr ON a.asset_id = sr.asset_id  
   WHERE at.manufacturer = 'SafeGrid'  
   GROUP BY a.asset_id  
   ORDER BY a.asset_id;
